GpuSortExec: expr=[l_shipmode@0 ASC NULLS LAST], time_us=250
  GpuProjectExec: expr=[l_shipmode@0 as l_shipmode, sum(CASE WHEN orders.o_orderpriority = Utf8("1-URGENT") OR orders.o_orderpriority = Utf8("2-HIGH") THEN Int64(1) ELSE Int64(0) END)@1 as high_line_count, sum(CASE WHEN orders.o_orderpriority != Utf8("1-URGENT") AND orders.o_orderpriority != Utf8("2-HIGH") THEN Int64(1) ELSE Int64(0) END)@2 as low_line_count], time_us=100
    GpuAggregateExec: group_by=[l_shipmode], aggr=[sum(CASE WHEN orders.o_orderpriority = Utf8("1-URGENT") OR orders.o_orderpriority = Utf8("2-HIGH") THEN Int64(1) ELSE Int64(0) END), sum(CASE WHEN orders.o_orderpriority != Utf8("1-URGENT") AND orders.o_orderpriority != Utf8("2-HIGH") THEN Int64(1) ELSE Int64(0) END)], time_us=1845
      GpuProjectExec: expr=[o_orderpriority@1 as o_orderpriority, l_shipmode@0 as l_shipmode], time_us=170
        GpuCoalesceBatchesExec, time_us=1
          GpuHashJoinExec: join_type=Inner, on=[(l_orderkey@0, o_orderkey@0)], projection=[1, 3], time_us=1335
            GpuCoalesceBatchesExec, time_us=1
              GpuFilterExec: predicate=(l_shipmode@4 = MAIL OR l_shipmode@4 = SHIP) AND l_receiptdate@3 > l_commitdate@2 AND l_shipdate@1 < l_commitdate@2 AND l_receiptdate@3 >= 1994-01-01 AND l_receiptdate@3 < 1995-01-01, projection=[0, 4], time_us=2252
                GpuScanExec: table=lineitem, projections=[l_orderkey, l_shipdate, l_commitdate, l_receiptdate, l_shipmode], time_us=34817
            GpuScanExec: table=orders, projections=[o_orderkey, o_orderpriority], time_us=32726

# sync_floor_us = cost of the measurement itself (empty timed region: clock + cudaStreamSynchronize on an idle stream). Each node time INCLUDES one PER OUTPUT PARTITION, since a node line is the Σ over its partitions; a node at or below its own floor (sync_floor_us x partitions) is unresolved, not cheap. Do not subtract it.
# nodes_total_us = Σ of the per-node times above; total_us = the whole query, end to end (parse + plan + serialize + node walk + materialize)
# build_profile = how the harness itself was compiled. total_us MINUS nodes_total_us is that Rust; records from different profiles are not comparable on it. Node times are device work and barely move.
build_profile=benchmarks opt-level=3
sync_floor_us=1
nodes_at_or_below_floor=2/10
nodes_total_us=73497
total_us=77264
